🎥🚔: Super Troopers 3 (2026)

The Vermont troopers are reporting for duty again, but keeping the peace might be the last thing on their minds. Farva’s extravagant engagement to Thorny’s sister has everyone preparing for a wedding that already looks destined to spiral completely out of control.

Meanwhile, a new drug operation puts the crew back on the case. Their investigation quickly becomes anything but professional as bad decisions, ridiculous pranks, and unexpected trouble follow them everywhere. Somehow, between chasing suspects and dealing with wedding chaos, the troopers have to figure out how to get the job done.

Super Troopers 3 reunites the Broken Lizard crew for another round of friendship, foolishness, and the outrageous comedy that has defined the franchise.

In theatres August 7. Get tickets now at Searchlight Pictures.

source_details.synopsis: Super Troopers 3 (billed as Super Troopers 3: Farva’s Wedding, onscreen only) is a 2026 American comedy film directed by Jay Chandrasekhar. A sequel to the 2018 film Super Troopers 2, the film was written by and stars the Broken Lizard comedy team, made up of Chandrasekhar, Kevin Heffernan, Steve Lemme, Paul Soter and Erik Stolhanske. Super Troopers 3 was released in the United States by Searchlight Pictures on August 7, 2026, it received mixed reviews from critics.
